answer: Make every agent post a refundable stake that is slashed when its attestations are later proven false. An attacker who spins up thousands of fake identities must lock real funds behind each one, so the cost grows linearly while honest agents keep their deposits. Think of it as a velvet rope that looks soft but admits only one verified guest at a time: each new dune of sockpuppets demands fresh capital, and a shared reputation nebula makes repeat cheating visible across the whole network.
